personal.tagline: I build AI-driven systems end to end — LLM integration, predictive models, and the scalable backends that carry them

about.description: I'm a Software & AI Engineer building AI-driven solutions end to end. I graduated with Honors in Software Engineering from Mustaqbal University in 2025 (GPA 4.6/5), and I now engineer scalable backend architectures and lead LLM integration at Kafaat. My work spans the full path from data to product: integrating Large Language Models like Google Gemini and OpenAI, building Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines for semantic search, training supervised models for predictive analytics, and architecting the ASP.NET Core and Node.js services that put all of it in front of real users. Before Kafaat I completed a Software Engineering COOP at Clear Vision Co. in Riyadh, where I optimized CI/CD pipelines to cut deployment time by up to 20%, led architecture and technical solution design for enterprise projects, and mentored junior interns on clean-code practices. What I care about is reliability: an AI feature that only works when the model cooperates isn't finished — so I design multi-LLM fallbacks, deterministic defaults, and behaviour I can actually verify. I'm focused on advancing AI innovation within Saudi Arabia's tech ecosystem, with particular interest in Arabic NLP, data engineering, and MLOps.

projects.title: AI-Powered Tender Management System
projects.description: A secure, web-based tender and bid-management platform with role-based access control and identity management through EF Core. Its predictive-analytics module uses supervised learning to estimate deal values and budget ranges from historical tender data. I engineered the data-preprocessing pipelines, optimized the LINQ and EF Core queries for high-performance SQL Server interaction, automated document retrieval through ID-based routing, and generated stakeholder-specific, audit-ready PDF compliance reports.
projects.impact: Supervised-learning module that predicts deal values and budget ranges from historical tenders, wrapped in an RBAC-secured system that produces audit-ready compliance reports automatically.

projects.title: Student Collaboration Portal — AI Study Buddy
projects.description: A scalable student file-sharing and collaboration platform I led a 4-member team to build. I integrated Google Gemini to create a context-aware "Study Buddy" with NLP-based PDF summarization and semantic search, and implemented real-time collaboration, live chat, and full CRUD through WebSockets with real-time database synchronization. Backend optimization improved file-sharing efficiency by 40%.
projects.impact: 40% improvement in file-sharing efficiency; LLM-powered study assistant with PDF summarization and semantic search, delivered as team lead of 4 developers.

projects.title: E-Commerce Real-Time Product Pipeline
projects.description: A real-time data-ingestion pipeline for e-commerce product updates, built on a Kafka producer/consumer architecture with JSON Schema validation. I designed a bronze/gold lakehouse-style architecture on Delta Lake for reliable persistence, orchestrated the workflows with Apache Airflow, and implemented a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline to power intelligent, context-aware product search.
projects.impact: End-to-end data engineering: streaming ingestion, schema-validated lakehouse storage, orchestrated workflows, and a RAG layer that turns raw product data into semantic search.

projects.title: Young Heroes — Bilingual Learning Game for Kids
projects.description: A full-stack learning game for children aged 5–10: eight games across mathematics and language, character customisation, and an XP/level progression system, in English and Arabic. I architected an adaptive-difficulty algorithm driven by real-time analysis of player performance, and built a multi-LLM fallback across OpenAI and Google Gemini so question generation stays available even when a provider fails — with a deterministic algorithmic generator underneath when no API key is configured at all.
projects.impact: Multi-LLM fallback architecture with a deterministic generator underneath — the AI enriches the game but can never break it. Runs entirely in the browser, no account and no data leaving the device.

projects.title: Smart Quran App
projects.description: A cross-platform, offline-first mobile application for reading the Quran, with 100% of its functionality available without a network connection. Includes a rule-based Smart Mood Verse recommender, bookmarking, customizable reading and memorization plans, advanced navigation, local notifications with Android 13+ permission and time-zone handling, and an accessible UI with advanced Arabic text rendering — all persisted securely on-device.
projects.impact: 100% offline by design — every feature, including the intelligent verse recommender, runs on-device with no network dependency and no user data leaving the phone.
